correctness.rationale: PASS. The Alexander dual face test is that each induced four-set is connected; full 2-skeleton, tree tetrahedra, pentagon 4-simplices and no larger simplices follow from forbidding C3 and C4. Private triangle rows for star/path tetrahedra, plus incidence C5 blocks for the five tetrahedra of each pentagon, yield a full-rank unimodular minor in d3 of rank c4-c5. Distinct pentagons have disjoint 4-path supports, d4 has primitive image of rank c5, and ker d3/im d4=0 integrally. H2 is free of rank choose(n-1,3)-c4+c5, D simply connected and Hurewicz-Whitehead gives wedge of S2; Alexander duality shifts the degree to n-5. Independently generated qualifying 4- and 5-faces, verified no qualifying 6-faces and checked mod-2 boundary rank for C8, C10, C5+three isolates and two disjoint C5 (rank examples (8,8,0,27), (10,10,0,74), (8,5,1,31), (10,10,2,76)); inspected repository script also supplies Petersen/dodecahedron cases. No claim on original complex homotopy type or girth<5.
